purpose: Require every privileged POST route to pass the registered operation-policy broker before route-specific parsing, authentication and atomic/service execution guards.

policyStates.admit: Continue to route-specific authentication and execution guards.
policyStates.admit-degraded: Continue while preserving degraded dependency posture in policy evidence.
policyStates.deny: Return HTTP 403 before the route handler.
policyStates.unavailable: Return HTTP 503 before the route handler.
policyStates.worker-only: Allow the authenticated internal worker route to continue.
policyStates.not-registered: Allow normal router fallthrough so unknown POST paths remain 404.
